blocks.text:
Icons tinted from the wallpaper, the way iOS does it, so the Home screen takes its colour from the picture behind it and changes when that does.

Badges are tinted too, each one in its own app's colour rather than red, which keeps them readable against icons that have all gone the same shade.

A built-in Folio theme. Applying it changes how Folio draws your Home screen and nothing else - it never touches other apps, and every setting it changes can be changed back by hand in Settings.

items: Badges in each app's own colour

entries.notes: The Tinted theme becomes a package in the Folio Market. It has shipped with Folio since 0.4.0.
